name: @workerv2/product
description: Worker V2 Product Platform — the immutable, versioned, content-addressable product definition system: product model, versioned catalogs, product validation, canonical serialization, hashing, constraints, capabilities, the resolver chain that resolves a product + content into a BlueprintSource (never a Blueprint), and the compatibility model between products, processing profiles, runtime capabilities, and blueprint schema versions. Pure data + pure functions; NO rendering, NO layout, NO execution, NO storage.
